_meta.lens: Infinity-Nikki-style material dev: dreamy pastel palettes, soft glows, iridescent hints, whimsical accents, tasteful sparkle; hero materials get restraint, utility materials get variety.
_meta.grounding: Parameter substrings must match a parameter that provably exists on the parent master (the applicator never invents names; it matches substrings against the parent's live parameter list and skips unmatched entries). Value ranges are authored here; concrete per-instance values are deterministically seeded by asset name so re-runs are idempotent.
_meta.specimen: Saved/Audit/owner_instance_profiles.json holds the owner's hand-tuned instances; when it exists the applicator reports how many policy parameters coincide with the owner's vocabulary.

_rules: Scalar names containing the substring match case-insensitively; first matching rule wins; remaining entries are skipped.
Multipliers apply to the parent's default value when the instance has no override (read default via MaterialEditingLibrary), never to an existing authored override.
Vector rules set palette colors with optional per-instance hue jitter (seeded, within +/- 4%) so siblings vary without breaking family identity.
Emission/Glow intensity rules only apply when the parent exposes an emission-ish parameter (substring match); they scale with a small per-instance factor 0.8-1.25.

scalars.note: Tasteful tiling variance so swatches read differently.
Never above default; translucency stays subtle.
Enforce non-metallic dream look on toon materials.

family_policies.notes: Family selection is by asset-name prefix match (MI_<Family>_... or folder name); the applicator logs each family's matched-vs-skipped parameter names so the policy stays grounded in reality.
